ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement”), made as of the  day of February, 2020 by and between MICHAEL BERG and MARNI BRAND, as husband and wife, having an address at 277 21s Street, Brooklyn, New York, 11215 (collectively, “Owner"), and 276 20 STREET LLC, a Delaware 10023 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with a building and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Brooklyn,County of Kings,City and State of New York,known as and by the street address 277 21s Street, Brooklyn,New York 11215 and moreparticularly described inScheduleAannexed hereto and made aparthercof andknown as Kings County Tax Block 891,Lot 59 (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon orwhich maybelocated thereonin thefuture arehereinreferred to as the“Owner Buildings"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Buildings are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerParcel"): WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of 11215andmoreparticularlydescribed inScheduleB annexedhereto andmadea part hereof and known as Kings County Tax Block 891, Lots 26, 27 and 28, respectively (said land being collectively referred to herein as the"Developer Land"); WHEREAS,the Parties hereto are simuitaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions(the“Declaration")in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) in order to create a single zoninglotcomprised of the OwnerParcel and the Developer Land (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the“Merged Zoning Lot"), and as more particularly described on Schedule C annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with this Agreement; WHEREAS, all “parties in interest" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the “Exhibit II), annexed hereto as Exhibit 1, have joined in the Declaration or have waived or have previously waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement, or subordinated or previously subordinated their interest in the Merged Zoning Lot thereto (the Declaration, Zoning Lot Certification and such other documents, agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the"ZoningDocuments");
